desc:
I'd like to point out that Chimata's name is really weird in a simple way. 🤨 The "Chi" part is literally thousand, and the "Mata" part is literally "again". I mean, sure, it's supposed to be crossroads and relate her to being a chimatagami, but still.

Hmm... maybe "again" is a way of saying thousand twice? So it's technically "Chiji" (千々) which would basically be "thousands"
